gaps._comment: inter-chunk gap: 700ms(lower)-900ms(default)-1200ms(upper, tuned for speaker changes, too long for narrator-only mid-paragraph seams). Re-tuning = one ffmpeg pass, zero API calls.

tagger._comment: ON by default. 'auto' = claude if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, else codex if OPENAI_API_KEY + OPENAI_TAG_MODEL, else untagged with a printed recommendation. Tags carry the emotional cadence that makes the read sound like someone who has read the book; untagged, every chunk lands in the same flat register. This is a SECOND API bill on top of Fish. Opt out with 'none'.
